rakkasei namasu, julienned white daikon and orange carrot dressed in a creamy beige sweet vinegar sauce of ground roasted peanuts, a small heap in a bowl
orido nasu no dengaku, a round eggplant halved and pan-grilled, its cut face spread with thick glossy reddish-brown sweet miso and sprinkled with white sesame, on a plate

ja: なまり節と白玉葱のサラダ
desc: namaribushi to shiro-tamanegi salad, flakes of pale pinkish-brown boiled bonito mixed with thin white onion slices and green vegetables in a light dressing, in a bowl
tamago fuwafuwa, a pot of very fluffy pale yellow whipped egg risen like a souffle over clear dashi, with a pinch of green or nori on top, in a small earthenware pot
heso mochi, flattened round white steamed rice-flour dumplings each with a navel-like dent pressed in the centre, lined up on a plate with dark azuki paste beside them

ja: サクラエビのかき揚げ
desc: sakura ebi kakiage, a round loose cluster of tiny translucent pink sakura shrimp fried together in light batter, crisp and lacy, in a dark bowl
gawa, a cold soup of finely chopped pink raw bonito mashed with miso and pickled plum in icy water, with sliced cucumber, onion, shiso and ginger floating, in a white bowl
tororo-jiru, smooth frothy pale grey-white grated wild yam thinned with miso dashi, topped with shredded nori and green onion, in a bowl beside barley rice
someii, glutinous rice dyed bright yellow with gardenia, packed flat in a lacquered box and decorated with green leaves
saba hakozushi, pressed sushi in a wooden box, the white rice covered in sections with sweet flaked mackerel, sliced lotus root, carrot, shiitake, yellow egg and pink kamaboko
mikuriya soba, grey buckwheat noodles in a hot dark soy broth topped with chicken pieces, julienned orange carrot, sliced shiitake and green leaves, in a lacquered bowl
konbumaki, short dark brown-black rolls of glossy simmered kelp wrapped around dried herring, each tied in the middle with a pale gourd strip, cut to show the spiral, on a long plate
kuromame okowa, sticky white glutinous rice dotted with plump glossy black soybeans, in a white bowl
kobujime, thin slices of white fish and pink swordfish cured between sheets of kelp, slightly translucent and tinged amber at the edges, fanned on a long plate with garnish
yogoshi, chopped boiled dark green daikon leaves stir-fried in sesame oil and coated in miso, a glossy dark green heap on a plate
osuwai, julienned white daikon and orange carrot in sweet vinegar mixed with thin brown strips of simmered fried tofu, sprinkled with white sesame, in a glass bowl
